stories.title: After airport strike, Trump considering whether to join fight against Houthis

en.title: After airport strike, Trump considering whether to join fight against Houthis
en.summary: Following a strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, President Trump indicated the U.S. may participate in military operations against the Iran-backed Houthis.

en.title: Ukraine Shrugs Off Trump Call to Ditch Zelensky for Energy Strikes
en.summary: President Trump criticized President Zelensky's strikes on Russian oil refineries, while Zelensky stated he would cease such operations if Russia reciprocated.

en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified to Category 4 strength while moving toward Mexico's Pacific coast.

en.title: Terminal in Riyadh airport hit again, a day after deadly strike killed 12
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was struck again in an escalation of the conflict between Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia, following a previous attack that resulted in twelve deaths.

en.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" after criticizing Zelenskyy
en.summary: President Trump announced a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy responded by stating Russia bears sole responsibility for the war, following Trump's criticism of him.

en.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire, but Zelenskyy says this is 'news for me'
en.summary: President Trump claimed that Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire related to their ongoing conflict. Zelenskyy indicated he was unaware of such an agreement.

en.summary: Pope Leo XIV will undergo surgery this week after doctors identified a localized nodule in his lung during examination.

en.summary: Hurricane Simon, with winds of 155 mph, approached Mexico's Pacific coast early Sunday and was expected to move inland as an extremely powerful storm.

en.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after nodular lesion found in lung, Vatican says
en.summary: Pope Leo will undergo surgery to address a nodular lesion discovered in his lung. The pontiff has no previously documented health issues and maintains an active lifestyle.

en.title: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced plans to have surgery to remove an early-stage nodule found on his lung.

en.summary: An attack on a Saudi airport resulted in 12 deaths and has prompted consideration of potential U.S. military involvement in regional tensions related to the Iran conflict.

en.title: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
en.summary: A strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh killed 12 people of multiple nationalities and wounded over 300 others, with some in critical condition. The latest attack may prompt Saudi Arabia to seek increased military support from allies.

en.summary: A Wall Street Journal survey indicates economists expect bond yields to remain elevated due to persistent inflation, Federal Reserve actions, and government debt levels.
